objective: Use MTG as the canonical master silo and generate the broadest practical set of low-cost marketplace candidates without inventing demand, copying tenant data, or enabling unverified payment routes.

truth_contract.revenue_rule: independent buyer + settled external payment + correct offer attribution + completed fulfillment + retrievable delivery proof
truth_contract.demand_rule: Candidate category, active Stripe object, catalog entry, generated page, traffic, simulation, or EPV heuristic alone is not demand evidence.
truth_contract.provisioning_rule: This file and generated manifests are candidate blueprints only. No production database rows, DNS records, payment links, inventory, credentials, or workers are created by the generator.

canonical_master.role_policy: Master silo retains source inventory, provenance, pricing, fulfillment and trust rules. Clones receive schemas and templates only, never inventory, users, credentials or cross-silo vouches.

monetization_options_to_test_not_assume: transaction services only after payment and delivery rails pass
B2B value-added automation with explicit price and bounded deliverable
isolation_requirements: Every listing, offer, payment, order, vouch, task, file and analytics record is scoped to silo_id.
RLS policies and negative cross-tenant tests are required before provisioning.
Tenant-scoped foreign keys reject listing/payment/order relationships across different silos.
Public APIs expose published fields only, never service credentials or private inventory.
MTG, DreamMeez, adult/Amplissa and other silo data cannot bleed across boundaries.
go_live_gates: observed intent with buyer-facing problem, price and channel
working buyer intake and active checkout link verified at deployment time
signed payment event verification plus duplicate/replay tests
automated or explicitly disclosed fulfillment path

cube_policy.epv_policy: NZ$25/NZ$120 thresholds remain unvalidated heuristics until computed from qualified traffic and net contribution; they cannot alone authorize worker provisioning.
cube_policy.scale_after_sale: One silo at a time, after proof reconciles; scale only on measured net contribution, queue latency, error rate and fulfillment reliability.

silos.name: MTG Singles & Commander
silos.category: Trading card game singles, sealed product, Commander collections
silos.buyer_job: Find, list, compare and trade specific MTG printings with condition and provenance
silos.additional_gate: Signed settlement, safe trade locking, scoped vouches and delivery receipt must be verified.

silos.name: Avatar Cosmetics & Identity
silos.category: Cosmetic avatar items, supporter tiers, digital entitlements
silos.buyer_job: Buy and receive a cosmetic/supporter entitlement with a retrievable account receipt
silos.additional_gate: Verify one NZ$3.99 active link through signed webhook to one idempotent entitlement and account-visible delivery.

silos.name: Free B2B Supplier Directory
silos.category: Supplier profiles, capability listings and RFQ discovery
silos.buyer_job: Find a supplier, compare capabilities and request a quote
silos.additional_gate: Start with free listings and qualified RFQs; do not enable paid lead claims without verified contact delivery.

silos.name: Quote Comparison
silos.category: Supplier quotes, ETA, lead times, delivery terms and cost normalization
silos.buyer_job: Compare 2-5 supplier quotes without hiding unknown costs
silos.additional_gate: Verify secure intake, deterministic output, durable file delivery and active paid link before selling.

silos.name: Music & Media
silos.category: Records, CDs, media collections, audio media and memorabilia
silos.buyer_job: List and find media by release, format, edition, condition and location
silos.additional_gate: Source reliable catalog metadata and validate supply, buyer intent and rights-sensitive listing rules.

silos.name: Musical Instruments & Audio Gear
silos.category: Instruments, microphones, interfaces, amplifiers and studio equipment
silos.buyer_job: Find used gear with verified model, condition and included accessories
silos.additional_gate: Define fraud checks, serial/privacy handling and safe delivery.

silos.name: Women's Clothing & Accessories
silos.category: Pre-owned clothing, footwear, bags and accessories
silos.buyer_job: Find garments by size, measurements, material, style and condition
silos.additional_gate: Keep seller listing free during liquidity test; define counterfeit and returns policies.

silos.name: Baby & Kids
silos.category: Clothing, toys, nursery goods and age-appropriate equipment
silos.buyer_job: Find age/size-appropriate second-hand goods with clear condition
silos.additional_gate: Default-deny recalled or safety-critical products until a verifiable safety/recall workflow exists.

silos.name: Home & Garden
silos.category: Furniture, homewares, garden tools and household goods
silos.buyer_job: Find local goods with real dimensions, pickup and delivery terms
silos.additional_gate: Use local pickup defaults and do not promise delivery integrations before tested.

silos.name: Electronics & Gaming
silos.category: Consoles, accessories, computers and consumer electronics
silos.buyer_job: Compare used electronics by exact model, condition and included parts
silos.additional_gate: Add fraud, account-lock, stolen-goods and condition-disclosure controls.

silos.name: Sports & Outdoors
silos.category: Fitness, camping, cycling, water and outdoor equipment
silos.buyer_job: Find used equipment by size, spec, safety condition and location
silos.additional_gate: Safety-critical gear requires category-specific disclosure and eligibility rules.

silos.name: Books, Comics & Print
silos.category: Books, comics, manga, magazines and collectible print
silos.buyer_job: Find the right edition, printing, ISBN and condition
silos.additional_gate: Separate common used books from collectible editions and preserve accurate provenance.

silos.name: Collectibles & Vintage
silos.category: Vintage objects, memorabilia and collector goods
silos.buyer_job: Find niche items with authenticity and provenance signals
silos.additional_gate: Never label authenticity verified without independent evidence.

silos.name: Vehicle & Marine Parts
silos.category: Automotive, motorcycle, bicycle and marine replacement parts
silos.buyer_job: Match a part to make/model/year/specification and compatibility
silos.additional_gate: Safety-critical fitment and recalls need explicit compatibility warnings.

silos.name: Crafts & Creator Goods
silos.category: Handmade goods, art, craft supplies and creator merchandise
silos.buyer_job: Discover handmade goods with clear maker, materials and delivery time
silos.additional_gate: Distinguish ready stock from made-to-order and never fabricate ship dates.

silos.name: Pet Supplies & Hobby
silos.category: Pet equipment, accessories and non-live-animal hobby supplies
silos.buyer_job: Find appropriate pet equipment and hobby accessories by size/specification
silos.additional_gate: Live-animal sales, restricted products and unsafe health claims stay disabled.

silos.name: Business Equipment
silos.category: Commercial tools, office, kitchen and small-business equipment
silos.buyer_job: Find used equipment with service history, capacity and delivery terms
silos.additional_gate: Safety and regulatory claims require source evidence.

silos.name: Contractor Quotes & Variations
silos.category: Free quote intake, change-order records and ETA comparisons
silos.buyer_job: Compare variation requests, scope, evidence, price and schedule impact
silos.additional_gate: No legal or construction-compliance verdict without cited source and qualified human review.

silos.name: R&D Tax & Statutory Records
silos.category: Evidence organization and compliance data preparation
silos.buyer_job: Organize source evidence and missing documents into a reviewable evidence pack
silos.additional_gate: Preparation only until jurisdiction rules, expert boundaries and service fulfillment are reviewed.

economic_validation_protocol.first_7_day_experiment: Do not launch all verticals. Build candidate manifests and one intent measurement per candidate only after route readiness is proven; keep external publication approval-gated.
priority_order: MTG master data and fulfillment reconciliation
Billboard payment-link correction and inventory reservation/delivery proof
Free B2B supplier listings and quote intake
Remaining verticals according to observed supply and intent
demand_signal_ladder: independent settled purchase with fulfillment and delivery proof
explicit buy intent at stated price
qualified buyer request with scope and deadline
economic_validation_protocol.unit_economics: net contribution = settled proceeds - Stripe/processor fees - refunds/disputes - variable fulfillment cost - storage/API cost. Do not use top-line GMV or simulated EPV as profit.
economic_validation_protocol.gate: No silo enters production or CUBE expansion until its own gates pass. One silo's evidence does not automatically prove another silo's economics.
